decisions.statement: A run's ordinal carries at least two digits and as many as the count of runs needs.
Nothing here writes the domain page's part slugs.
A string id is found by mention as well as by assignment.
Only the string ids cross into the census.
The census is written as numbered runs with an aggregate composing those runs.
A run whose body is already there is not staged again.
A clone with no string id refuses the call.
The writing call that lands the staged bodies is named instead.
The staging folder is named as soon as this made it.
Each body staged is named as soon as that body is written.
A run that threw part way names in its refusal what it had staged.
The run count and the domain page's part slugs are written together.

definition: the command staging the census of the string ids the base game provides
